newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades Elscint.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman downgrades Elscint.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it had downgraded Elscint Ltd to 3-Neutral from 2-Outperform in the wake of disappointing third-quarter results.
Third-quarter earnings per share (EPS) were $0.01, well below Lehman's estimate of $0.25 and below $0.23 a year ago as gross margins plummeted, analyst Theodor Kundtz said in a report.
He said the company suffered from margin pressure across its product lines. "We do not expect significant improvement in margins over the near term," he said.
Lehman cut its fourth-quarter EPS estimate to $0.05 from a prior $0.29, its full-year 1996 estimate to $0.47 from $0.95 and its 1997 estimate to $0.40 from $1.05.
The Israeli company makes diagnostic imaging equipment.
